messages.title: 規 The rules
body: **1 · Be kind.** This is a small community and everyone here is helping.
**2 · Keep it closed.** The game is in closed test. Ask before sharing it outside the server.
**3 · One bug, one post.** In {#bugs}, so nothing gets lost.
**4 · No spam, no ads,** nothing you would not show a stranger.
**5 · Nobody pings @everyone.** A new build pings 告 New builds, and only the people who asked for it.
Invite links, scam links and mass mentions are held back automatically. The 守 Guardians see every one, and breaking the rules gets a warning, then a timeout.

messages.title: 告 Ninefold · The first closed test is open
body: **Nine realms stand between a mortal and the sky. You sit at the foot of the first.**
Ninefold is an idle cultivation game, painted in ink. Qi gathers on its own, even with your phone shut, and every choice is the same good problem: grow stronger now, or climb.
**What waits for you**
境 Nine realms and nine heavens, each with its own painted landscape
獸 Thirty-six hand-painted beasts, a warden at the end of every realm, and Dragons above the summit
職 Gear in five ranks, six schools, and fifteen classes you become by what you wear
洞 A cave that grows while you sleep, a vault that opens every few hours, a tower with no top
樂 Its own music, a road full of strangers, and a new quarry every week
**One promise above the rest: nothing is ever taken away for being away.** Close it for a week and your cultivator is further along, never behind. And losing a fight costs nothing, ever.
Play it the way you would if nobody was watching. Then tell us what confused you, what annoyed you, and what made you come back.

messages.title: 筆 Dev log #1 · Ninefold gets its face
body: The last stretch before the first testers was about how Ninefold looks, sounds and feels. The game underneath is the same. The face is new.
fields: 標 A logo
A gold brush ensō with the seated cultivator inside it. It is now the app icon, the splash when the game opens, the browser tab and this server.
樂 Its own music
Three tracks made for the game: two to cultivate to, one for the hunt. The music follows you from screen to screen and crosses between tracks without a gap. Its volume is its own, in the ≡ menu.
貴 A premium finish
Every card is mounted like a painting, with gold corners and a lacquer fill. Titles, numbers and buttons take the logo's lettering. The PC version wears the logo down its side.
書 A guide for everything
{#guides} holds fourteen posts, one per system, each with the real screen it explains. The classes have a chart of their own.
修 Fixes
The end of a fight scrolls on short screens and zoomed browsers. The day shows in the header again. *Report a bug* now sits in the ≡ menu.
▸ Next
The wardens and the heavens get their own music. After that, whatever you find. Tell us in {#bugs} and {#ideas}.

posts.title: 入門 Start here: your first hour
body: **Ninefold is an idle cultivation game.** Qi gathers on its own, even with the game shut. You spend it to grow stronger, or let it fill the bar and climb.
**Three promises the game keeps**
· Nothing is ever taken away for being away. Close it for a week and you come back further along.
· Losing a fight costs nothing. Not qi, not material, not a level.
· Nothing resets. Every realm adds something and keeps everything you had.
fields: ▸ The guide in the game walks you through this

1. Spend the qi your master left you on an upgrade.
2. Win your first fight: the rat.
3. Spend the 材 material it drops on 妖丹 Beast Cores.
4. Kill the same beast ten times, for its 熟 Known mark.
5. Fill the ninth layer, beat the realm's warden, and break through.
▸ The characters
Open ≡ Menu → *What the characters mean*. Any character with a dotted line under it says its name when you tap it.
▸ Every other guide
Fourteen posts in this forum, one per system,, in the order the game opens them. Ask your questions inside the post they are about.
▸ Found a problem?
≡ Menu → *Report a bug*, or open a post in {#bugs}.

posts.title: 氣 Qi, layers and the nine realms
body: Qi gathers at the full rate whether you are here or not, all night, with the phone shut.

**Sitting.** With the game open, gathering deepens up to three times as fast after a few minutes, for about a quarter of an hour (more with 神 the Spirit branch of the Path). A bonus for being there, never a cost for leaving.

**Layers.** Qi fills the bar, and a full bar opens a layer by itself. Nine layers make a realm. At the ninth, the realm's 守 warden comes out. Beat it, and 突破 Break through takes the next realm. Only you press it, never the clock.
**The trade.** Qi you spend on upgrades stops filling the bar. Choosing between the two is the whole game.
fields: ▸ The four upgrades

劍訣 Sword Technique: power
功法 Cultivation Method: qi per second
吐納 Breathwork: qi per second
妖丹 Beast Cores: power, bought with 材 material, not qi
▸ 滿 Full
Each realm holds so many levels of each upgrade. 滿 means this one is at its cap for now. Climb to hold more.
▸ The nine realms
練氣 Qi Refining · 築基 Foundation · 金丹 Golden Core · 元嬰 Nascent Soul · 化神 Spirit Severing · 煉虛 Void Refining · 合體 Unity · 大乘 Great Vehicle · 渡劫 Tribulation

posts.title: 狩 Hunting, the Record and Beast Cores
body: Beasts wait on the 狩 Hunt screen. Fight them whenever you like, as often as you like, for nothing. The percentage on each is your odds.
A fight is settled the moment you press, then plays back round by round. **Win** and you collect 材 material, sometimes a piece of gear. **Lose** and nothing is taken. Come back stronger.
Material is the second currency. Qi cannot buy it and waiting cannot earn it: it falls off beasts. It buys 妖丹 Beast Cores, and from the third realm a warden will not fall without them.
fields: ▸ 錄 The Record: every kill counts for ever

見 **Seen** at 1 kill: the first sight of a beast pays qi.
熟 **Known** at 10 kills: +2% 材 material from everything.
通 **Mastered** at 100 kills: +2% power.
▸ 緣 The bond
Every win fills a beast's bond. The tenth leaves a piece for certain, a rank above the best that beast has given you, and the bond starts again.
▸ 圍 Drive
Buy many kills of a beast you already know at once, instead of tapping for each.
▸ 期 The week's quarry
One beast each week pays double material, and its first kill that week pays qi. It moves every Monday.

posts.title: 器 Gear: ranks, sets, classes and refining
body: From the second realm, beasts leave gear. Tap a piece in your chest to wear it. **Six places:** 劍 Weapon, 袍 Robe, 冠 Crown, 靴 Boots, 珮 Talisman, 戒 Ring.
**Five ranks:** 凡 Common, 靈 Spirit, 玄 Mystic, 地 Earth, 天 Heaven. The rank multiplies every line on a piece. Lines are percentages, so an old piece stays good.
Gear power has no ceiling. Qi from gear has one.
fields: ▸ 系 Sets
Wear several pieces from one realm and its lineage pays on top.
▸ 職 Classes
Every line belongs to a school: 劍 Sword, 氣 Qi, 運 Fortune, 體 Body, 器 Artificer, 法 Arts. Wear three pieces of one school and its class wakes. Two schools together make a pair class.
▸ 煉器 Refining
Material makes a piece you wear better, for ever. No top level, and the levels stay on the piece, so refine the one you mean to keep.
▸ 煉 Fusing and 拆 Melting
From the third realm, three of a kind fuse into one of the rank above. Anything you will not wear melts into qi.

posts.title: 職 Classes: what you wear is who you become
body: Ninefold has no class menu. **Every piece of gear belongs to a school**, by the line it leads with, and what you wear decides who you are.
· **3 pieces** of one school wake it.
· **5 pieces** bring it to its full.
· **3 and 3** of two schools wake both, and together they make one of **fifteen named classes**, each with a perk no school has.
Changing class is changing clothes. It costs nothing, and you can go back whenever you like. So every piece that drops is also a question: who are you becoming?
The item sheet tells you before you wear anything: *Wearing it makes you a Vajra*, or *ends your Wanderer*. The 器 Gear screen shows your class and how many pieces the next step needs.
fields: 劍 Sword Cultivator · 劍修
Leads with 力 Power. Power +10%, or +20% at the full.
氣 Qi Cultivator · 氣修
Leads with 氣 Qi rate. The four upgrades cost 8% less, or 15% at the full.
運 Fortune Seeker · 運修
Leads with 運 Rarer gear, 拾 Drop chance. Your 運 rarer gear and 拾 drop chance lines count ×1.5, or ×2 at the full. A bond fills in 9 wins, or 8 at the full.
體 Body Cultivator · 體修
Leads with 破 Beasts weaker. Your 破 beasts weaker lines count ×1.5, or ×2 at the full.
器 Artificer · 器修
Leads with 煉 Fusion quality, 藏 Chest slots. Refining costs 12% less, or 22% at the full. Your 煉 fusion quality and 藏 chest slots lines count ×1.5, or ×2 at the full.
法 Arts Cultivator · 法修
Leads with 法 Art. The arts in your sequence strike 15% harder, or 30% at the full.

body: Wake two schools with three pieces each and you become one of these. You keep both schools' first steps, and the class adds a perk of its own on a system no school touches.

posts.title: 道 The Path, Keystones, Stances and Arts
body: **道 points** come from climbing: one for every three layers, two for every warden, and more from the heart demon and the Bestiary. They are spent on the tree in 道 the Path.
The tree has three branches, 劍 the Sword, 神 the Spirit and 運 Fortune, with gold bridges between them. Tap a node to read it before you take it.
fields: ▸ 樞 Keystones
From the fourth realm: three nodes that take something away to pay for what they give. Each is stronger than the node beside it, and each closes a door.
▸ 勢 Stances
Always on. You hold the stance of every realm you have reached, and choose which one you fight in. It changes every round of every fight.
▸ 法 Arts
Three in an order, one firing each round, then looping. Every warden gives up its own art when it falls.

posts.title: 洞天 The Cave and 秘境 the Secret Realm
body: **洞天 The Cave** (second realm). Three beds. Plant 材 material and it ripens into qi over real hours. A ripe bed waits for you for ever. It is the one thing that grows while the game is shut, and it pays for coming back to pick it.

**秘境 The Secret Realm** (third realm). A door opens every few hours. Seven rooms, two ways on at each, and every other room is a beast a realm above you. Nothing is carried in, so losing takes nothing back.
fields: ▸ 秘境深 The Deeper Vault
From the seventh realm the path goes further: eleven rooms instead of seven, two more guardians, and the deepest rooms in the game behind them.
▸ This week
Each week one herb is worth planting and one room of the vault pays double. It changes every Monday.

posts.title: 閉關 Seclusion, 塔 the Tower and 圖鑑 the Bestiary
body: **閉關 Seclusion** (fourth realm). Shut the door for eight hours and your 心魔 heart demon comes: yourself, darkened, without what you know. Beat it for a 道 point. Nine in a life, two a realm, and a loss costs nothing: it comes back in an hour.

**塔 The Endless Tower** (fifth realm). One floor, one beast, no top. A floor pays material and, once, six hours of your own gathering in qi. Every nine floors earn a seal: +15% material from everything.
**圖鑑 The Bestiary** (sixth realm). A realm whose four beasts you have all 熟 Known pays a 道 point. Going back to finish an old realm pays for the tree.

posts.title: 雷池 The Tribulation, 爐 the Furnace and the Heavens
body: **雷池 The Tribulation** (ninth realm). The last layers of the whole climb. When they run out, the bar becomes the thunder pool, and a Dragon waits at the end of it. Every crossing earns a 雷印 thunder mark, and the Dragon comes back heavier every time you put it down.
**爐 The Furnace** (ninth realm). Pills, brewed from qi and material together, kept for good, with no cap. Power is what shortens a crossing.
**The Heavens.** Thunder marks open nine heavens above the summit, and each one offers a 悟道 card: one of three, your choice.
fields: ▸ The nine heavens
真仙 True Immortal · 金仙 Golden Immortal · 太乙 Supreme Unity · 大羅 Grand Veil · 准聖 Quasi-Sage · 聖人 Sage · 道祖 Dao Ancestor · 混元 Primordial Unity · 鴻蒙 The Uncarved
▸ And after that
The Tower has no top, the week turns every Monday for ever, and the 天榜 Heaven List counts thunder marks past the summit.

posts.title: 期 The week and the road
body: **期 The week** turns every Monday. It marks a beast worth double 材 material, a herb worth planting and a room of 秘境 worth reaching. It never touches the rate you gather at, so nobody falls behind for missing one.

**緣 The road.** Somebody is on the road every few hours: a child begging at a shrine, a pool with nothing living in it, and many more. One choice, and walking on is always free. Nothing is taken that you did not offer, and the road remembers what you did.

posts.title: 榜 Rankings, saves and devices
body: Your game lives on the device and the browser you play on. The app, Chrome and a PC are separate games unless you sign in.
**Joining the rankings** takes a name, then either nothing (a guest, on this device) or an email: you get a link, and the same cultivator opens in any browser where you use it. No password, ever.
Every climb on the boards is checked against real time on the server, so nobody can edit or clock their way up.
fields: ▸ The three boards

天榜 Heaven List: the furthest climb.
期榜 This Week: layers climbed since Monday.
塔榜 The Tower: the highest floor.
▸ On the Android app
Join as a guest. The email link opens the browser, not the app.
▸ Without an account
≡ Menu → *Your save* → *Copy the save*, and on the other device *Restore from a copy*.

posts.title: 問 Questions testers ask
body: **Do I lose anything if I stop playing for a while?** No. Qi gathers the whole time, and nothing is ever taken away for being away.
**What does a lost fight cost?** Nothing. Try the beasts you are not sure about.
**Is there anything to buy?** No. There is no shop and no ads in the test.

**The APK download stops at 100%.** Discord opened it in its own browser, which cannot ask you to keep an APK. Tap ⋮ then *Open in Chrome*, download it again and tap *Download anyway*. If it still sits there, look in Chrome ⋮ → Downloads: the file is usually already there.
**Can I play on my phone and my PC?** Yes. Sign in with your email in the browser on both. The Android app plays as a guest.
**The music is too loud, or I want it off.** ≡ Menu has one button for the sound and one for the music: on, quiet or off.
**What do the characters mean?** ≡ Menu → *What the characters mean*. Every character has an English name beside it or under a tap.
**How do I report a bug?** One post in {#bugs}: what you did, what you expected, what happened, and the *Build* line from the foot of the ≡ menu.
